csv_agency: Florida Dept of Transportation Contracts Division
csv_scope_of_work: The Department requires professional services of a Consultant to provide a wide range of engineering and planning services to include technical, management and supportive tasks for the Department s Transportation Systems Management & Operations (TSM&O) Program. The Consultant will provide a wide variety of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) services that include but are not limited to: transportation statistics, architecture, standards, deployment, ITS design, integration, operations, maintenance, telecommunications, mainstreaming, traveler information, emergency response functions, GIS, training and multimodal systems. The Consultant may be called upon to provide ITS construction engineering, and inspection (CEI) activities to support District and Central Office deployments of TSM&O.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, ITS Design, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies
